mentions.description: This tool records and replays AI image and video generation API calls to any provider, letting people save money by avoiding live API calls during testing. It is part of the Lumenfall AI media model gateway.

mentions.name: Lumenfall
mentions.description: This is an AI image and video model gateway that lets users access generative image/video models through one service. It is adding a simulation mode that provides free fake responses during development instead of pricey real generations.
mentions.problem: Real AI image and video generations are pricey during development, so developers need a way to test with free fake responses.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We‘ve built an AI image and video model gateway called https://lumenfall.ai.

Right now I‘m working on adding a „simulation“ mode, that allows anyone to get free fake responses during development, instead of pricey real generations.

mentions.name: Lumenfall
mentions.description: This platform provides a unified API for AI image generation — an 'OpenRouter for Images' — with video generation following. Its roadmap includes observability that uses fine-tuned vision models as a judge to monitor production traffic, and it offers a model arena/showdown leaderboard that ranks models by task (e.g. photorealism) so developers can pick the best model. The stack uses Rails for the dashboard and Cloudflare Workers (TypeScript/Hono) for the engine.
mentions.audience: Developers building applications that generate AI images and video
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://lumenfall.ai

Right now we are "OpenRouter for Images", with video following this week.

Our north star is creating a broader developer platform for AI media generation that includes observability, with fine-tuned vision models as a judge to monitor production traffic.

We also have a model arena and showdown page that ranks models by task, so you can find the best model for e.g. photorealism: https://lumenfall.ai/leaderboard
